meta.title: BroilerHQ — Next-generation smart farm management
meta.description: Thermal imaging, digital tracking for poultry and cattle, and AI-powered farm management — on one platform.

hero.subtitle: Thermal imaging, digital livestock tracking and AI-powered farm management. Catch illness before it spreads and keep track of every bird and cow on one platform.

visual.label: Live thermal camera view of a poultry shed, with one bird flagged for high body temperature

technology.title: Three layers of intelligence for your farm
technology.description: Cameras, sensors and software working together, so you decide with data instead of guesswork.

thermal.title: Spot sickness from body heat
thermal.description: Thermal cameras scan every bird's body temperature and alert you the moment signs of fever or heat stress appear.

tracking.title: A digital identity for every animal
tracking.description: Smart tags and GPS collars keep each cow's, or each flock's, location, movement and health history in one place.

platform.title: Your whole farm on one dashboard
platform.description: Feed, vaccinations, mortality, sales and costs — every number in real time, right from your phone.

poultry.title: Catch fever before symptoms show
poultry.description: A sick bird's body temperature usually rises before visible symptoms appear. Our AI analyses the heat map of every shed around the clock to find abnormal changes.

points.perBird: Temperature detection for every individual bird
points.alerts: Instant alerts on your phone, in Bangla or English

visual.label: 24-hour chart of average body temperature, showing an abnormal rise in the evening
visual.title: Shed 03 · Average body temperature

cattle.title: Know where every cow is, and how it's doing
cattle.description: GPS collars and smart ear tags record each cow's location, movement, rumination and rest. If an animal leaves its zone or its behaviour changes, you know right away.

points.signals: Early signals for heat (oestrus) and illness
points.history: Complete health and vaccination history per animal

visual.label: Pasture map showing one cow that has left its assigned zone

platform.label: Every record for the whole farm

steps.title: A modern farm in three steps

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Mount thermal cameras in your sheds and smart tags on your animals — our team helps with setup.

analyze.title: Analyse
analyze.description: AI continuously analyses temperature, movement and farm data to surface risks.

act.title: Act
act.description: Get timely alerts and recommendations, act early and cut your losses.

cta.title: Get your farm ready for the future
cta.description: Built for everyone, from family farms to large commercial operations.
